_doc: Warrior subclasses (docs/plans/warrior-subclasses.md). The chosen subclass is the PC string attribute "subclass", wiped at remort. Skill bans and gains are <subclasses> nodes in each skill XML (node named after the subclass: <level> gives the skill, <level>-1 bans it), read by C++ GenericSkill. This file holds what Fenia reads (dreamland_fenia utils/subclass): the gates of the choice (profession, level, min/max race size from .tables.size_table, minimum trainable stat caps) and the weapon rules of the subclass skills (an off-hand weapon must fit too): weapon_classes = any weapon of these classes, banned_classes = never these, one_handed = no two-handed weapon, shield = a shield must be worn. A subclass missing here gives no gains through its weapon rules, and its skills refuse with weapon_refusal.

bladestorm._doc: cooldown in seconds between two spins; moves cost = skill level / move_div, at least 1.

weapon_refusal.en: This takes a sword or an axe in hand, and nothing else.
weapon_refusal.ru: Для этого нужен меч или топор в руках, и ничего другого.
weapon_refusal.ua: Для цього потрібен меч або сокира в руках, і нічого іншого.

con_scale._doc: Thorns and bulwark grow with current con above base, up to cap: scale = min(cur_con, cap) - base, 0..8.

bulwark._doc: A successful shield block adds a charge, up to max. A block with max charges fires a free bash with the shield and empties them. bonus_pct: chance per point of con scale that one block adds two charges. The charges are an affect of duration ticks, renewed by every block, so they fade out of combat.

thorns._doc: Damage to the attacker on a block: dice(skill level / dice_div, dice_size) x (8 + con scale) / 8, never lethal. shrug_pct: base chance (attacker's luck counts) to take none.

phalanx._doc: A one-handed spear and a shield: shield block chance + block_bonus (and its cap with it), thorns x thorns_pct / 100.

shield_throw._doc: cooldown in seconds between two throws; away = seconds after a throw with no shield block; targets = enemies hit at most; daze_div = the first target is dazed with chance skill / daze_div.

weapon_refusal.en: This takes a shield on your arm and a one-handed weapon that is not a polearm.
weapon_refusal.ru: Для этого нужен щит на руке и одноручное оружие, не алебарда.
weapon_refusal.ua: Для цього потрібен щит на руці й одноручна зброя, не алебарда.
